sources_page.title: Data Sources
sources_page.subtitle: No mock data: every number comes from these sources.
sources_page.name: Source

warning_codes.CANAL_NOT_CREDITED: Canal water is counted as 0 m³: no official canal water allocation (duty) data is available yet. Add a borewell or tell us your canal water share for a better plan.
warning_codes.CACHED_PRICES: Prices for {{crops}} are from cached data, not live.
warning_codes.CACHED_WEATHER: Weather data for {{district}} is from cache, not live.
warning_codes.ASSUMED_BOREWELL: No borewell yield was given, so groundwater is counted as 0 m³. Tell us your borewell capacity for a better plan.
warning_codes.DISTRICT_AVERAGE_SOIL: Soil data is a district average.
warning_codes.PRICE_NOT_ADJUSTED: No seasonal price adjustment for {{crop}} (limited history).
warning_codes.SINGLE_CROP_ELIGIBLE: Only one crop had real prices: {{crop_id}}.
warning_codes.SINGLE_SEASON_COMPARISON: {{crop_id}} takes a full year, so a single season cannot be compared fairly.

excluded_reasons.NO_REAL_PRICE: {{crop_id}} not included: no Agmarknet price found for {{district}}.
excluded_reasons.NO_YIELD_DATA: {{crop_id}} not included: no yield data for this district.
excluded_reasons.DATA_UNAVAILABLE: {{crop_id}} not included: required source data is unavailable.
excluded_reasons.NOT_SOWABLE_NOW: {{crop_id}} not included: not in sowing window.
excluded_reasons.NOT_GROWN_IN_DISTRICT: {{crop_id}} not included: not commonly grown in {{district}}.
excluded_reasons.WATER_INFEASIBLE: {{crop_id}} not included: water requirement exceeds available supply.
